# Data Center MEP Contractor | Tier III & Tier IV

> Building high-performance mission-critical environments designed to power the future of digital infrastructure with reliability, efficiency & operational continuity.

## Overview

MENASCO delivers integrated MEP and infrastructure solutions for mission-critical data centers across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, the United Kingdom, and the United States. Beyond core MEP capabilities, our scope extends to civil works, modular data center white space manufacturing, and energy infrastructure.

By combining these capabilities with in-house fabrication, established procurement networks, and strategic supplier relationships, we maintain greater control over the supply chain, reduce project dependencies, and protect quality and delivery schedules even under challenging market conditions. From initial concept to operational readiness, MENASCO brings complex data center developments to life.

Our expertise extends across the full project lifecycle, from early-stage coordination & value engineering to final commissioning & operational readiness, ensuring efficient execution, optimized performance & long-term reliability.

At MENASCO, we are committed to delivering resilient, scalable & future-ready infrastructure that supports the evolving needs of data-driven industries & the growing digital economy.

## Capabilities

- Complete MEP Solutions: Mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection for white space, grey space and support areas, coordinated in a federated BIM model and commissioned as one package.
- Critical Power Infrastructure: MV and LV switchgear, transformers, substations and power E-Houses, generators, UPS and A/B distribution to the rack, in N+1 and 2N topologies with provision for SMRs.
- Cooling & Precision HVAC Systems: Chilled-water plant, CRAH/CRAC units and aisle containment, plus coolant distribution units and secondary loops for direct-to-chip liquid cooling, sized to ASHRAE conditions.
- Modular Whitespace Fabrication: Prefabricated white space modules, pipe racks, corridor modules, plantroom skids and riser assemblies, built and tested off site, then delivered on a sequenced logistics plan.
- BMS, Automation, Security & ELV: BMS, power monitoring (EPMS) and PLC controls with alarming and DCIM integration, plus structured cabling, access control, CCTV, intrusion detection and fire alarm interfaces.
- Civil and Enabling Works: Site preparation, excavation, foundations, equipment plinths, cable trenches, duct banks, drainage and builder's works, sequenced with MEP installation to protect the programme.
- Scalable & Future-Ready Infrastructure: Engineering flexible and scalable infrastructure solutions designed to support future expansion, technology upgrades & evolving operational demands.

## Modular MEP Fabrication for Data Centers

In-house fabrication gives MENASCO direct control over complex and difficult supply chains. Critical MEP assemblies are built and tested under our own quality control, reducing reliance on third-party lead times and protecting the site programme.

### Modular & prefabricated

- Modular MEP white spaces
- Prefabricated E-Houses
- Pipe racks and vertical service risers
- Mechanical plant and equipment skid modules
- Duct and pipe assemblies

### Power & controls

- Automatic transfer switch (ATS) panels
- PLC and electrical control panels
- LV main and sub-main distribution boards (MDB / SMDB)
- Motor control centres (MCC)
- Capacitor banks for power factor correction
- High-current feeder and plug-in tap-off busway

### Air distribution

- Galvanised ductwork fabricated to SMACNA
- Phenolic and PIR pre-insulated duct panels
- Motorised and pressure-independent volume control dampers
- Curtain fire dampers
- Duct sound attenuators

## Local energy markets: Understanding local energy infrastructure is part of the engineering

### Data centers in the United Arab Emirates

Rapid hyperscale expansion in Abu Dhabi and Dubai is placing new demands on power generation, transmission capacity, and utility infrastructure. Grid connection schedules, substation delivery, high ambient temperatures, and cooling efficiency must be addressed early, with electricity procurement and generation arrangements differing between the emirates [1] [2].

**Key market constraints:**

- Utility capacity, substation approvals, and energization schedules
- Cooling performance during extreme summer temperatures
- Emirate-specific power procurement and self-generation arrangements

#### MENASCO's Data Center Advantage in the United Arab Emirates

With our international engineering, procurement, and project management teams headquartered in Dubai, MENASCO can coordinate utility requirements, electrical infrastructure design, and long-lead equipment sourcing from a single operational hub. Direct UAE construction capabilities, in-country manufacturing and established supplier relationships allow substation works, cooling infrastructure, and off-site modular prefabrication to progress in parallel, reducing dependencies between utility readiness, equipment delivery, and construction milestones.

**MENASCO's Competitive Advantage:**

- Engineering, procurement, fabrication and construction management in one UAE headquarters
- Faster technical coordination from a single operational hub
- Tighter control of the procurement and delivery interfaces that delay projects

Link: https://menascogroup.com/services/data-centers#united-arab-emirates

### Data centers in Saudi Arabia

Saudi Arabia's expanding data center market must balance large-scale AI infrastructure demand with extreme heat, water scarcity, and evolving regulatory requirements. Cooling architecture, electricity supply, and equipment procurement require early planning, while data center service providers must address registration and classification requirements under the Communications, Space and Technology Commission (CST) [3] [4].

**Key market constraints:**

- Water-efficient cooling and high-temperature system performance
- CST registration and applicable facility classification requirements
- Utility planning and long-lead electrical equipment procurement

#### MENASCO's Data Center Advantage in Saudi Arabia

Saudi Arabia's extreme temperatures and water scarcity demand cooling systems optimized for local conditions, while rapid data center expansion places pressure on specialist equipment supply chains. MENASCO is skilled in delivering closed loop direct-to-chip liquid cooling, as well as traditional configurations against project-specific PUE and WUE targets. Drawing on international suppliers and in-country fabrication to source equipment, dedicated construction teams adapt solutions to local codes, utility requirements, and minimize reliance on external delivery partners.

**MENASCO's Competitive Advantage:**

- Direct-to-chip liquid cooling expertise
- In-country fabrication and a global sourcing network
- Directly managed Saudi construction teams

Link: https://menascogroup.com/services/data-centers#saudi-arabia

### Data centers in Egypt

Egypt's position as a regional connectivity hub offers opportunities for data center development, but investors face challenges involving land allocation, construction permits, telecom licensing, and infrastructure readiness. Coordinating power availability, fiber connectivity, regulatory approvals, and imported equipment procurement early is essential to establishing realistic construction and commissioning schedules [5] [6].

**Key market constraints:**

- Land allocation, development permits, and telecom licensing
- Power infrastructure and reliable carrier connectivity
- Imported equipment procurement and customs coordination

#### MENASCO's Data Center Advantage in Egypt

Egypt's reliance on imported specialist equipment and variable infrastructure readiness can delay data center construction. MENASCO addresses these constraints through Egyptian manufacturing facilities capable of producing modular data center white spaces, E-Houses and prefabricated MEP assemblies locally, reducing the need to import completed modules. International procurement teams source specialized components while local construction teams coordinate utility connections and civil works, allowing manufacturing and site development to progress in parallel.

**MENASCO's Competitive Advantage:**

- Local manufacturing of modular MEP units
- International sourcing of specialist components
- Less reliance on imported finished systems, with scope to shorten schedules

Link: https://menascogroup.com/services/data-centers#egypt

### Data centers in Europe

European data center development faces increasing grid connection delays, limited available power capacity, and tightening energy-efficiency requirements. Site selection must account for utility connection timelines, electricity costs, and national permitting rules, while cooling efficiency, waste heat recovery, and energy performance reporting play an increasingly important role in facility design [7] [8].

**Key market constraints:**

- Grid connection queues and transmission capacity
- EU energy-efficiency reporting and country-specific requirements
- Waste heat recovery and low-carbon electricity sourcing

#### MENASCO's Data Center Advantage in Europe

Grid connection delays and increasingly demanding energy-efficiency regulations can limit the feasibility and timing of European data center developments. MENASCO's scale of international engineering resources support early assessment of electrical capacity, phased infrastructure requirements, and cooling configurations incorporating heat recovery where viable. UK-based teams coordinate technical development and global equipment sourcing, while qualified local partners address country-specific regulations and utility interfaces, allowing procurement and construction planning to respond to confirmed power availability.

**MENASCO's Competitive Advantage:**

- Centralized technical resources and international procurement capacity
- Flexibility to adapt to constrained grid access
- UK-led coordination with local regulatory support

Link: https://menascogroup.com/services/data-centers#europe

### Data centers in the United States

US data center development is increasingly constrained by electrical equipment supply and a growing shortage of skilled construction tradespeople. Availability of electricians, pipefitters, HVAC technicians, and other specialized workers place pressure on labor costs and schedules. With large power transformers facing multi-year lead times, early procurement, workforce planning, off-site prefabrication, and phased energization are essential for hyperscale and AI infrastructure projects [9] [10].

**Key market constraints:**

- Grid interconnection and utility service agreements
- Long-lead transformers, switchgear, and electrical equipment
- State and local permitting, with phased power availability
- Skilled trade labor shortages and construction workforce staffing

#### MENASCO's Data Center Advantage in the United States

MENASCO's international procurement network expands access to qualified manufacturers beyond domestic suppliers, while centralized engineering teams coordinate alternative equipment specifications and modular fabrication opportunities. Direct US contracting partnerships enable civil works, prefabricated MEP installation, and phased electrical infrastructure to be aligned with equipment deliveries and utility energization milestones. Established relationships with staffing agencies across the United States also provide access to skilled construction tradespeople, helping address regional labor shortages, scale site workforces, and maintain construction schedules on large-scale data center developments.

**MENASCO's Competitive Advantage:**

- Global procurement networks to manage equipment shortages
- Centralized engineering expertise
- US construction capabilities that adapt to utility delays
- Nationwide staffing relationships for skilled construction trades

Link: https://menascogroup.com/services/data-centers#united-states

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What does MENASCO deliver as a data center contractor in the UAE?

Complete MEP and civil works, delivered as one package. MENASCO delivers the civil and structural works alongside power infrastructure, cooling systems, fire protection, monitoring systems and the supporting MEP services, all engineered together for reliability, scalability and continuous operation.

### How does MENASCO keep data centers reliable?

Through redundancy and precision at every layer. MENASCO builds in redundant power, precision cooling and continuous monitoring, and designs every system around uptime and stability, backed by high-quality execution and close coordination on site.

### Can MENASCO build data centers that scale with future demand?

Yes. MENASCO designs power, cooling and critical MEP systems for phased, seamless expansion, so capacity can grow with demand and new technology can be integrated without major disruption to live operations.

### What does MENASCO's data center installation cover?

Everything from site assessment to handover. MENASCO covers site assessment, MEP coordination, installation of critical power and cooling systems, containment, BMS integration, testing and commissioning, and final handover, so each facility is ready to operate from day one.

### Which industries does MENASCO deliver data centers for?

Any organisation that depends on always-on digital infrastructure. MENASCO delivers data centers for finance, healthcare, government, telecommunications, cloud and technology providers, e-commerce and large enterprises that need secure, high-availability facilities.

### Why do clients choose MENASCO as their data center contractor in the UAE?

Because MENASCO combines engineering depth with dependable delivery. Clients rely on its mission-critical MEP capability, precision and focus on operational continuity to deliver data centers that are secure, efficient and ready for future growth.

### Does MENASCO provide testing and commissioning for data centers?

Yes. MENASCO tests and commissions every mission-critical system, including power, cooling, fire protection and monitoring, to confirm it performs efficiently, safely and to international standards before handover.

### Can MENASCO coordinate MEP on complex mission-critical data center projects?

Yes. Mission-critical coordination is a MENASCO specialty: it integrates mechanical, electrical, plumbing, ELV and fire protection systems with high precision to support uninterrupted operation and maximum efficiency.

### Does MENASCO make data centers more energy efficient and sustainable?

Yes. MENASCO integrates energy-efficient cooling, optimised power infrastructure, smart monitoring and sustainable engineering practices that lower operating costs and reduce environmental impact.

### How does MENASCO approach data center MEP differently from conventional projects?

With mission-critical standards throughout. Data centers demand far higher reliability, precision, redundancy and continuity, so MENASCO engineers every system around uptime, thermal management, backup power, resilience and future scalability.

### Can MENASCO upgrade or retrofit an existing data center?

Yes. MENASCO upgrades, retrofits and expands live facilities, from power upgrades and cooling optimisation to infrastructure enhancement and system modernisation, while keeping operational disruption to a minimum.
